profileSummary.text: Fullstack developer with over a year of experience on production meeting-notes and IoT products. Works on features end to end: APIs, web and mobile screens, testing, release, and production fixes.

projects.narrative: A meeting assistant that turns long recordings into summaries, decisions, and action items you can search later. Worked on capturing recordings and showing progress.
Open-source tool where a team of AI roles (planner, developer, security, QA) builds software for non-developers, and nothing is accepted until real checks pass.

employmentBullets: Built resumable multipart uploads for recordings over 100 MB: after a dropped connection the upload continues from the last finished part, with retries that respect the server's backoff.
Added local backup of in-progress recordings on web and mobile, so a crash or closed tab no longer loses a meeting.
Built the Sensio IoT backend for room controls: users send a command and see the device's real state, even when it is offline, with per-user permissions.
Turned design mockups into working web and mobile screens.
Fixed production issues and shipped releases alongside the infrastructure and security engineers.

4: Adapted an open-source AI chat app for the program project: authenticated APIs, model discovery and routing, and deployment.
6: Built the cloud side of the Parentify capstone with Mobile Development and Machine Learning teammates.
